section_summary.extract_value: This section presents bivariate and ANCOVA analyses comparing heterosexual and sexual minority women on body appreciation (BAS) and related variables. Sexual minority women were significantly older (M=29.17 vs. M=27.17), had higher BMI (M=27.56 vs. M=25.61), and were more likely to have a bachelor's degree or higher. After controlling for age, BMI, sexual relationship status, and education level, sexual minority women showed significantly higher body appreciation scores (adjusted M=3.77) compared to heterosexual women (adjusted M=3.60), with BMI being the only other significant predictor of BAS.
